key_insight: A new global linear-attention mechanism for machine-learning force fields captures long-range interactions with O(N) cost while preserving physical symmetries (equivariance/invariance). It gives global awareness without the quadratic compute of standard attention.
problem_solved: Accurately and efficiently modeling long-range interactions in molecular dynamics is expensive or relies on fragmentation/physics-based patches; this method provides a scalable, symmetry-preserving alternative that integrates into ML force-field models.
method: Design a linear-cost attention operator that aggregates global context in O(N) time and memory instead of O(N^2).
Enforce symmetry preservation (equivariance/invariance) so forces and energies respect physical constraints.
Provide a modular implementation that can replace or augment existing long-range modules (fragmentation or physics-based fixes) in ML force fields.
impact: Enables scalable, accurate MD modeling for larger systems and longer simulations with lower compute and memory, making advanced ML force fields practical for more real-world chemistry and materials tasks.

paper_title: Linear attention goes global in molecular dynamics
